source_coverage.claim: No full-visual-coverage claim; unknown remains unknown.

results.killed_claim: Every adapter should look or speak the same to preserve one concept.
results.survivor: Only declared protected semantics and provenance are invariant; presentation may vary by adapter.

results.killed_claim: A plausible deeper need, motive, or causal explanation can be stored as if the user directly said it.
results.survivor: Raw observation, interpretation/hypothesis, and independently validated derived fact must remain separately typed and provenance-bound.

results.killed_claim: A local metric improvement can authorize promotion despite downstream protected-outcome regression.
results.survivor: Local wins cannot override the frozen human-important outcome, but workloads without a downstream surface may mark the profile NOT_APPLICABLE.

results.killed_claim: An aggregate pass implies the effect is acceptable for every material context, or any tiny post-hoc segment may veto the aggregate.
results.survivor: Material evidence-bound contexts/cohorts may block a global diagnosis and force targeted analysis; arbitrary or immaterial post-hoc segmentation cannot.

next_gate: Attack observation/inference layering across user research, runtime diagnosis, and legal/operational evidence; attack context-conditioned telemetry on real multi-cohort or multi-environment failures. No canonical patch before same-workload evidence.
